title: DPDP classification
promptText:
You are helping an Indian government / PSU officer apply a practical DPDP-aligned data sensitivity check before using any AI tool.

Classify each item in the list below into Tier 1–4 and justify in one sentence:

Tier 1 — Public: gazetted / published / press content → consumer AI OK
Tier 2 — Internal: drafts, memos, non-public schemes → enterprise AI + no-training clause preferred
Tier 3 — Confidential: PII, Aadhaar-linked data, FIRs, tender evaluations, unpublished financials → on-prem / local SLM only
Tier 4 — Classified: cabinet / national security grade → air-gapped only

Also answer:
1. May this content be pasted into ChatGPT / Claude consumer chat? Yes/No
2. Safer alternative workflow if No
3. Redaction checklist before any upload

Output as a table: Item | Tier | Why | Consumer AI? | Next step

ITEMS:
[Paste document titles, field names, or short excerpts — redact real PII first]
